title: Using GPT-4 for content moderation
summary: We use GPT-4 for content policy development and content moderation decisions, enabling more consistent labeling, a faster feedback loop for policy refinement, and less involvement from human moderators.
body: We use GPT-4 for content policy development and content moderation decisions, enabling more consistent labeling, a faster feedback loop for policy refinement, and less involvement from human moderators.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布在其内容审核与策略开发中全面采用GPT-4，通过大模型实现更一致的标签分类、更快的策略迭代反馈循环，并减少人工审核的介入。原始信息显示：We use GPT-4 for content policy development and content moderation decisions, enabling more consistent labeling, a faster feedback loop for policy refinement, and less involvement from human moderators.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Using GPT-4 for content moderation”。其重要性主要体现在：该应用展示了大型语言模型在真实世界复杂内容治理中的实际效用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
